response:
The new keyword is optional (`response_schema=None`), and the SDK field uses `NotRequired`, so existing callers and SDK payloads need not supply either. The submission also preserves the old `Interrupt` representation when no schema is provided.

However, the LangGraph change is not minimal and fully backwards compatible. In `prebuilt/tool_node.py`, it adds unconditional `except GraphBubbleUp: raise` branches around tool-call wrappers. Those branches apply even when no response schema is used. Previously, exceptions from those wrappers reached the existing `except Exception` / `handle_tool_errors` logic; now `GraphBubbleUp` exceptions bypass it. That changes existing wrapper error-handling behavior independently of the optional schema feature.

The submission also adds a new public exception and graph-loop resume-write handling, extending the provider change beyond the optional schema/type additions. Most importantly, the unconditional tool-wrapper behavior change violates the requirement that callers using no schema retain their prior behavior.

FAIL
